components.css: .ds-ementa{list-style:none;margin:5px;padding:0;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);border:2px solid var(--brand);outline:2px solid var(--brand);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}.ds-row{display:grid;gap:6px;padding:16px 16px 8px}.ds-row:hover{background:var(--sunk)}.ds-row p{margin:0;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}.ds-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(min-content,auto) minmax(10px,1fr) auto;align-items:baseline;column-gap:8px}.ds-top a{font-family:var(--display);font-size:24px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}.ds-leader{display:block;height:0;border-bottom:2px dotted var(--edge);position:relative}.ds-leader::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-2px;border-bottom:2px dotted var(--brand);clip-path:inset(-4px 100% -4px 0);transition:clip-path 200ms ease-out}.ds-row:hover .ds-leader::after{clip-path:inset(-4px 0 -4px 0)}.ds-tier{display:inline-flex;border:2px solid var(--t-good);background:var(--t-good-bg);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 14px;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-leader::after{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
The guide is an ementa, the paper menu of a Lisbon tasca, printed in one colour of blue ink on table-paper white. A Restaurant is a line: name, dotted leader, Verdict. The leader carries the eye from a name to its call, so a diner compares tables by reading down one edge. The system refuses the category default of a photo card with a star score.

Surfaces are flat paper framed by blue double rules; the page is quiet, the Verdict is the loudest thing on it. Recognisable with content removed: a blue double rule on paper, dotted leaders, round pips. There are no gradients in surfaces and no photographs; one soft paper lift is the only shadow.
keyCharacteristics: One ink: blue carries brand, links, actions, rules and focus. Tomato appears only on the stamp and red flags; menu green only on Good-side Tiers and positives.
Double-rule frames (2px rule plus a second 2px rule 3px outside) mark the ementa, the Report hero, the sample report, state pages and the filter sheet.
Dotted rules (2px, edge) divide sections and join name to Verdict.
Round pips and dots carry meaning (Tier 1-5, Confidence 1-3) alongside words.
Light and dark themes share one structure; only values change.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only interactive and brand colour. Tomato is for the stamp and red flags, green for Good-side Tiers; neither is used as decoration.

rules.name: The Never-Hue-Alone Rule
rules.body: Tier is carried by label plus pip count (1 to 5 filled round pips) plus fill. Confidence is carried by dot count (1 to 3) plus its word. Trend is carried by arrow plus word. Colour never stands alone.

rules.name: The Dashed Means Unsure Rule
rules.body: A dashed outline on a Tier or status atom means a provisional Tier or Not enough evidence. Nothing else uses a dashed border there.

rules.name: The NEE Is A State Rule
rules.body: Not enough evidence is a state, not a Tier: no pips, no Tier colour, a dashed muted frame at card radius. It is never ranked or coloured like a Tier.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Fill Rule
rules.body: In lists and chips, text on a tinted Tier fill is ink; Tier colours are borders and pips. The one exception is the Report's large Verdict, which is solid Tier colour with paper-colour text. A provisional large Verdict stays tinted with ink text and a dashed rule.

rules.name: The Ledger Only Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime appears only on figures that must align: price, counts, dates, percentiles, Evidence numbers. Never on names, headings, labels or running copy.

rules.name: The Step-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: New text takes a named step above. A new literal size needs a reason and a place in this list.

rules.name: The Verdict Vocabulary Rule
rules.body: Copy never calls a Verdict a score, rating or grade. Say Verdict, Tier, Confidence.

rules.name: The Paper Lift Only Rule
rules.body: One shadow token. No extra elevation on hover; hover changes tone (Sunk row) or draws the leader.

dos: Do give every Tier, Confidence or status atom a shape cue (pips, dots, arrow, dashed outline) and a word.
Do frame the ementa, Report hero, sample report, state pages and sheet with the blue double rule.
Do join a name to its Verdict with the dotted leader; draw it on hover and focus in 200ms ease-out and drop the animation under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep Not enough evidence a dashed state with no pips and no Tier colour.
Do use Courier Prime for price, counts, dates and Evidence figures only.
Do use the highlighter inset band for the one main reason on a screen.
Do make every tap target at least 44px tall; keep Book full width on phones.
Do keep text at 12px or above.
donts: Don't use gradients in surfaces or fills, or any shadow beyond the paper lift.
Don't call a Verdict a score, rating or grade, or show a star or score pill as the Verdict.
Don't signal Tier or Confidence by hue alone.
Don't use a dashed outline on a Tier or status atom except for provisional Tier or Not enough evidence.
Don't treat Not enough evidence as a Tier.
Don't use tomato or green as decoration; tomato is the stamp and red flags, green is Good-side.
Don't add a coloured side stripe to cards or flags; frame them all round.
Don't use photographs or imagery that implies a listed Restaurant; the example is fictional and stamped.
Don't put a kicker, eyebrow or uppercase caption above headings. The stamp is the only uppercase text.
